policy.pricing_text: FRAs at the 30 Jan close (1x4 3.75, 3x6 3.49, 6x9 3.38, 9x12 3.36 vs WIBOR 3M 3.90) price roughly 55bp of NBP cuts within 12 months. The MPC meets on 3-4 Feb after holding at 4.00% in January; Glapiński (15 Jan) put the terminal rate near 3.5% and excluded neither February nor March.
policy.risk_text: The 4 Feb decision is a close call (PAP survey 10 hold / 8 cut): a hold lifts short FRAs, a cut extends the front-end rally; if cuts slip beyond March the roll-down does not materialise.

macro.projection_text: NBP November 2025 projection: CPI 2.9% (2026), 2.5% (2027); the March 2026 projection comes with the 3-4 Mar MPC.
macro.fiscal_text: 2025 general-government deficit ~7.0% of GDP; 2026 budget deficit cap PLN 271.7bn (in force; at the Constitutional Tribunal for follow-up review), gross borrowing needs ~PLN 690bn.
macro.fiscal_risk_text: 2026 needs ~30% (29 Jan) financed; budget accounts PLN 183bn at end-January; Fitch reviews Poland on 27 Feb (after the close) and Moody's on 20 Mar, both with negative outlooks.
macro.backdrop_text: The NBP held at 4.00% on 14 Jan; December CPI 2.4% y/y (final), core 2.7%; 2025 GDP grew 3.6% (30 Jan). Ratings: Fitch A- negative, Moody's A2 negative, S&P A- stable. 30 Jan-1 Feb: GUS put 2025 GDP at 3.6% (in line); MoF's February plan has sale auctions on 11, 18 and 25 Feb (PLN 7-12bn each) and budget accounts near PLN 180bn; non-residents added PLN 4.6bn of POLGBs in December (11.8% share). Abroad: Trump named Kevin Warsh as Fed chair (30 Jan) - the dollar index rose 0.8%, gold fell 9% and silver 26%; S&P moved Italy to a positive outlook; a partial US shutdown began on 31 Jan.

calendar.plan_text: MoF February plan (30 Jan): sale auctions on 11, 18 and 25 Feb (PLN 7-12bn each), no switch auction, a 33-week T-bill auction on 6 Feb; January sales were ~PLN 41.6bn incl. additional sales. BGK placed PLN 1bn of FWA0931 (Armed Forces Support Fund) privately (29-30 Jan).
calendar.timing_text: Within each auction week of the Aug 2025-Feb 2026 sample, yields drifted lower into the auction and the auction-day close was the cheapest point relative to the preceding session, so new buying is best executed at the auction-day close (11, 18 and 25 Feb). January auctions were absorbed with 1.4-1.9x cover. The 3-4 Feb MPC is the next event (a close call).

Later releases used where published by the info cut-off (GUS, Eurostat, BLS, ONS, CZSO, KSH; ECB/BoE/CNB 5 Feb).
facts.core_text: Regime: the NBP paused at 4.00% with ~55bp more priced, the ECB is on hold at 2.00%, the Fed holds into June, the BoE eases gradually, the CNB and MNB are on hold. Poland's 5Y CDS was 57bp and the 10Y spread to Bunds 227bp on benchmark bonds (Erste, 30 Jan close). Warsh nomination (30 Jan): dollar up, precious metals crashed; S&P Italy outlook positive.

quasi_takeaways: FPC fixed lines trade ~{lo}-{hi}bp over the POLGB curve (average {avg}bp); widest ASW {widest} at {widest_asw}bp. Same State Treasury guarantee as POLGBs.
Best pickup: {best} ({best_sp}bp vs POLGB). For buy-and-hold books the guarantee makes the pickup attractive; liquidity is the cost (Pekao became BGK market maker on 13 Nov 2025).
Supply: BGK placed PLN 1bn of FWA0931 for the Armed Forces Support Fund privately (29-30 Jan); no FPC auction had been announced for February yet. FPC spreads are tight to POLGB, so pickups are thin.
Use auctions, not Catalyst: trades are small retail lots and some lines go weeks without a print.
